summary: Mt. Peter is a standing 80-ft Aermotor LS-40 tower in McNairy County, TN, linked to the TN Division of Forestry; build date and ownership unresolved.

access.note: Ownership disputed: NHLR names TDF as administrator but its details also read 'Privately Owned'; the nominator believes it is private and unmarked. Editorial advice, not stated in the record: treat as private and do not climb until ownership is confirmed.

events.note: Listed as extant (standing) in the Tennessee Division of Forestry fire tower study, as of March 26, 2014.
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register on August 6, 2023 as US 1753, TN 57.
Visitor report from the 8/5/23 site visit says the stair treads had recently been replaced.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 691 ft (211 m); Tennessee Landforms lists 699 ft. The brief's 210.6 m matches the registry, so the registry figure is kept.
NHLR names TDF as administrator yet its details also read 'Privately Owned', and the nominator believes the site is private. Recorded as private pending a landowner or TDF statement.

notes_for_editor: No build year found in the NHLR entry, the Tennessee Landforms list, or the NRHP study, so the story says so. Access moved from the brief's 'unknown' to 'private' on conflicting sources; a landowner or TDF check is needed before any access claim. The NHLR description says its writer made the climb on the 8/5/23 site visit; the story does not repeat this, and its do-not-climb advice is editorial, not stated in the record. The Tennessee Landforms code '8-17' is a state forest district-tower number from a 1976 list (per the Landforms legend) and was not used. Height is converted from 80 ft. Elevation conflicts (691 vs 699 ft) are noted. Staffing and fire history were not found in any source read.
